scope: Same-host client timing, official service counters and coarse npu-smi fields. No prompts or generated text. Not a function-level scheduler profile.

restore.note: KV/prefix cache cold after restart; re-seed before benchmark

limits: One non-profiled and one profiled round; difference is not a causal profiler-overhead estimate.
Chunk timestamps do not identify every generated token.
npu-smi target interval was 1 s, observed interval was about 2 s, HBM is capacity display rather than bandwidth.
Frontend traces contain metadata and envelope, no attributable CPU scheduling scopes.
